title: EU funds and TFP growth: how the impact changed over time and space
core_idea: Investigate how European Structural and Investment Funds (ESIFs) affect regional total factor productivity (TFP) growth by computing TFP while accounting for heterogeneous capital accumulation across 262 NUTS2 regions (2000–2019), using annualised regional expenditure and distinguishing temporal phases (pre‑crisis, crisis, recovery) and regional development levels, and disentangling effects of ERDF, ESF, CF and EAFRD.
tldr: Assess whether and how different EU cohesion funds influence regional TFP growth over 2000–2019, accounting for varied capital accumulation, time periods (2000–2008, 2008–2014, 2014–2019), spatial development levels, and fund types.
